newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK boy's tall tale about skipping school.
newsitem.headline: HK boy's tall tale about skipping school.

text.p: A 12-year-old Hong Kong boy clambered 25 floors down a drain pipe to avoid his mother finding out he had skipped school, newspapers reported on Saturday.
Yeung Yam was at home on Friday playing a video game when he heard his mother return early.

The boy climbed out the kitchen window and scaled down the pipe on the side of his high-rise building. But his escape plan was thwarted after startled residents saw him outside their windows and called the police.
He was taken to hospital for observation and later released, the paper said.
